scope: Dequantize requested IQ4_NL rows one-by-one into the active pinned ring, eliminating the multi-row gather/value arrays and final staging copy

amdahl.zero_cost_ceiling: the removed copy is about 0.825 ms per p512 request in telemetry, far below the added per-row Python/dequant overhead
amdahl.overlap_exclusions: complete prefill wall includes gather/dequant and staging copy; do not add telemetry subwindows separately
amdahl.strict_fallback: the vectorized multi-row gather/dequant plus one copy remains the sole production path

workload: four-category canonical p512; five counterbalanced prefill pairs per category; one complete code-p512 tg128 diagnostic pair

decode_diagnostic.stopped_reason: The complete binding prefill gate lost all 20 pairs and the first decode pair also lost, so further GPU time could not change rejection.

validation.red: staging-ring oracle failed while the redundant gather_rows boundary was still called
validation.green: temporary direct route passed exact staging and 19 focused tests

decision: Reject and remove. Eliminating a sub-millisecond copy by dequantizing 16 rows individually loses 1.67% complete p512 prefill and the first decode pair; vectorized multi-row dequantization is worth its tiny final copy.
